name: Windscribe
author: Windscribe Limited
description: Windscribe controls for Omarchy in a terminal-grade panel: one-key connect, live traffic, exit search with favourites, Firewall, protocol and port selection, IP rotation, and allowance tracking.

barWidget.description: Connect, change locations, inspect tunnel traffic, rotate your IP, and control the Windscribe Firewall from the bar.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Status poll interval while the panel is closed. Open panel polls every 3 seconds.

schema.label: Preferred Protocol
schema.description: WireGuard, UDP, TCP, Stealth, or WStunnel, optionally followed by :port. Empty lets Windscribe choose.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Alerts on connection and unexpected drops.

schema.label: Interface motion
schema.description: Animates tunnel flow and state transitions.
